comparison_target: Same student-disjoint split and same next-response test targets (24,306 rows) for all paired seeds.

DKT-64-AdamW_minus_DKT-64-Adam.interpretation: This is a descriptive percentile bootstrap across three paired random seeds, not an equivalence test or a sufficiently powered inferential confidence interval.

DKT-96-AdamW_dropout_minus_DKT-64-Adam.interpretation: This is a descriptive percentile bootstrap across three paired random seeds, not an equivalence test or a sufficiently powered inferential confidence interval.

limitation: With three seeds, the analysis cannot establish equivalence, a zero effect, or power for differences below a pre-specified practical threshold. The intervals quantify observed seed-to-seed imprecision only.
